v01: A plain NFC sticker holds 504 bytes.
v02: That's room for a whole song.
v04: Pick a song, then hold a blank sticker to the back.
v05: It burns the tune on, page by page, in under two seconds.
v07: Nothing goes on the SD card. The song is a standard NDEF text record, so phones can read it too.
v08: It writes the length last, so a torn burn reads as blank, never half a song.
v09: Then it reads the sticker back and checks every byte.
v10: Tap it in Play, and the Flipper plays it straight off the sticker.
v11: It burns NTAG213, 215 and 216 stickers, from a short jingle to 250 notes.
v12: NFC Cartridges. Songs that live on a sticker.
